200001.desc:
[Special Challenge] Prevent Integrated - Primordial Nightmare from performing no more than 3 State Switches throughout the entire battle.

[Stage Overview]
At the start of combat and upon recovering from Stun, the Boss will have half its Daze gauge filled.
When <color=#FFAF2C>Swift Flying Sword</color> hits the Boss, it prevents them from performing a <color=#FFAF2C>State Switch</color> for a period of time.
Whenever the Boss's <color=#FFAF2C>accumulated Daze</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>reduced Miasmic Shield</color> reaches a certain threshold, it will attempt a <color=#FFAF2C>State Switch</color>. If it succeeds, the Boss's current <color=#FFAF2C>Daze</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield</color> values undergo a <color=#FFAF2C>proportional conversion</color>.
When Agents perform a Defensive Assist, Perfect Dodge, or Ultimate, or apply an Attribute Anomaly to the enemy, the cooldown of <color=#FFAF2C>Swift Flying Sword</color> is reduced.
While the Miasmic Shield is active, Agents <color=#FFAF2C>blocking the Boss's attacks will additionally reduce the Miasmic Shield value</color>.

200003.desc:
[Special Challenge] Prevent "Integrated - Drowned Ideal - Komano Manato" from ever entering <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield Frenzy</color>.

[Stage Overview]
In combat, the Boss starts with half of its Miasmic Shield value. Agents' attacks will not <color=#FFAF2C> reduce its Miasmic Shield value</color>. Triggering a Defensive Assist, or landing an Ultimate, EX Special Attack, or Assist Follow-Up <color=#FFAF2C>on the Boss while its blocking</color> will <color=#FFAF2C>break the Boss's blocking state and reduce its Miasmic Shield value</color>. When the Miasmic Shield value is reduced to zero, the Boss will immediately become Stunned.
The Boss gains Miasmic Shield value when its <color=#FFAF2C>attacks hit</color> an Agent or when it <color=#FFAF2C>blocks</color> an Agent's attack. If the Boss's Miasmic Shield accumulates to its maximum value, he will enter <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield Frenzy</color>. In this state, "Integrated - Drowned Ideal - Komano Manato" <color=#FFAF2C>cannot be interrupted</color>, and his aggression increases.

200005.desc:
[Special Challenge] Don't let Agents accumulate 20 stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color>

[Stage Overview]
During combat, the Boss will leave a zone called <color=#FFAF2C>Starlight Arena</color> on the field every 10s. Agents within this zone will gain 1 stack of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> every 1.5s. <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> has a maximum of 20 stacks.
Each stack of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> increases all Agents' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 40% and causes the currently active Agent to continuously lose HP.
Agents can transfer 2 stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> to the Boss by triggering a Defensive Assist or a block. Triggering a Dodge Counter will transfer 1 stack of Etch to the Boss. Inflicting an Attribute Anomaly on the Boss transfers 4 stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> to the Boss. Stunning the Boss transfers all stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> to the Boss. When the Boss's accumulated <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> reaches the maximum number of stacks, all <color=#FFFFFF>Etch</color> stacks are detonated, dealing DMG to Integrated - Shining Promise - Billy equal to a percentage of his Max HP, and restoring HP to all Agents' equal to 50% of their lost HP.
When the Boss successfully deals DMG with certain attacks, 2 stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Etch</color> are transferred to the Agent.
